description: Maps common vanilla blockstate property names to CraftEngine property types and reserved behavior. Only registered CraftEngine 26.8 property types are emitted; unknown enums are handled by the analyzer as `string` with an explicit values list.
note: half maps to double_block_half (upper/lower: doors, tall plants). Trapdoor's half (top/bottom) is resolved to single_block_half by the analyzer based on the observed values. For property name `type`, `shape`, `face`, `part`, `mode`, `orientation` no fixed enum type can be chosen; the analyzer emits `type: string` with a values list.
